# Quantum Hub PDF Compressor

> Quantum Hub PDF Compressor is a browser-based PDF compression tool that processes supported PDF files locally using WebAssembly. The application is designed so that PDF content does not need to be uploaded to a PDF-processing server.

Quantum Hub PDF Compressor is a standalone application associated with Quantum Hub.

## Tool

- [PDF Compressor](https://compress.quantumtools.site/): Compress PDF files using local browser-based WebAssembly processing.
- [Quantum Hub](https://quantumtools.site/): Main Quantum Hub utility website.

## Information

- [Privacy Policy](https://compress.quantumtools.site/privacy): Information about data handling and local browser processing.
- [Terms of Service](https://compress.quantumtools.site/terms): Terms governing use of the compressor.
- [Licenses](https://compress.quantumtools.site/licenses): Open-source and third-party software licenses.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/Sanketp899/quantum-hub-pdf-compressor): Public source repository for the compressor application.

## Technology

- React
- TypeScript
- Vite
- WebAssembly
- qpdf WebAssembly for lossless structural optimization
- Ghostscript WebAssembly for deeper PDF image compression

## Privacy

PDF files selected for compression are processed locally in the user's browser. The application is designed not to upload PDF contents to a PDF-processing backend.

## Compression Modes

- Lossless: structural PDF optimization without intentional image-quality reduction.
- Balanced: high-quality compression with moderate image optimization.
- Maximum: stronger image compression for smaller files.
- Extreme: aggressive image compression intended for smaller output files.

## Third-Party Software

- Ghostscript 10.08.0
- @wasm-zoo/ghostscript
- qpdf / pdfstudio components
